data.name: Integrations_ClaudeSteps
data.value: 1. Install Claude Code on this computer if you have not: claude.com/claude-code 2. Click Connect. Edgepad adds its plugin to Claude Code. 3. Restart open Claude Code sessions, or type /reload-plugins in them. 4. On your phone, open Controls > AI.

data.name: Integrations_CodexSteps
data.value: 1. Install Codex on this computer if you have not: developers.openai.com/codex 2. Click Connect. Edgepad adds its plugin to Codex. 3. In Codex, type /hooks and trust Edgepad. In the Codex app: Settings > Hooks > Review hooks. 4. On your phone, open Controls > AI. It appears once Codex sends its first event.
